text: JSC Rosneftegaz is in 100% federal ownership — owned by the Russian state.
short: Rosneftegaz is 100% owned by the Russian state.

source.name: Rosneft Oil Company: Shareholder structure (shareholders register data as of July 1, 2021)
source.quote: JSC ROSNEFTEGAZ is in 100% federal ownership. The Russian Government's direct share (through the Federal Agency for State Property Management) in Rosneft's equity is 0.000000009%.
source.note: Footnote 1 of Rosneft's published shareholder table: the state's direct holding in Rosneft itself is negligible; the state stake runs through 100%-federally-owned Rosneftegaz.

additionalSources.name: Коммерсантъ: Путин разрешил «Роснефти» совершать сделки с ее акциями
additionalSources.quote: Крупнейшим акционером «Роснефти» является государственная компания «Роснефтегаз»: ей принадлежит 40,4% акций.
additionalSources.note: Translation: 'Rosneft's largest shareholder is the state company Rosneftegaz: it owns 40.4% of the shares.' Kommersant calls Rosneftegaz a state company.
